clues.text: God told Job to look at this great creature, which He made along with Job himself.
God described to Job a mighty beast that feeds on grass like an ox.
God told Job about a creature with great strength in its loins and power in its belly muscles.
In God's words to Job, this beast's tail sways like a cedar.
God told Job this creature's bones are tubes of bronze and its limbs are rods of iron.
God told Job this beast lies under the lotus plants, hidden among the reeds of the marsh.
God told Job this creature stays unafraid even when the Jordan surges up to its mouth.
